title: TrustLens Normalized Observation
description: Phase 2 WP2 STEP 3/6/7/8/11/12. A typed, span-anchored DERIVED FACT about an input envelope, standing strictly between raw input and indicator observations. An observation says what was observed (a request, a threat, an identity claim) and — critically — its POLARITY (affirmed vs negated), its ATTRIBUTION (first-party instruction vs reported/quoted description) and its ACTOR/ACTION/TARGET frame, so that the deterministic layer can reason over structure rather than keywords, and the G-07 suppression layer can make its directional decisions deterministically. An observation carries NO indicator, NO rule reference, and NO verdict/score/severity — those belong downstream. Shape only; resolution and the verdict-ban are enforced by knowledge/validation/validate_extraction.py.

observation_type.description: The kind of fact. REQUEST/ACTION carry a frame; THREAT/TEMPORAL_PRESSURE carry pressure; IDENTITY_ASSERTION carries a claimed identity; PAYMENT_CONTEXT carries payment_direction; LINK_ACTION references a url_id; AUTHENTICATION_ACTION covers credential/OTP/PIN handling; DEVICE_ACTION covers install/permission/link/remote/wallet/USSD.

source_input_id.description: The input_id of the envelope this observation was derived from. Every observation traces to exactly one input.

status.description: STEP 12. The epistemic state. OBSERVED = present and determinate. AMBIGUOUS = present but under-determined (e.g. payment direction unresolved). UNKNOWN = could not be determined. NOT_OBSERVED = affirmatively absent (feeds negative context). NOT_APPLICABLE = the question does not arise for this input. Missing evidence is UNKNOWN, never benign.

polarity.description: STEP 6. Whether the observed content is asserted or negated. 'Share your OTP' is AFFIRMED; 'never share your OTP' is NEGATED. A NEGATED credential/device request projects to the directional negative indicators (NEGATED_CREDENTIAL_REQUEST / NEGATED_ACTION_REQUEST) and MUST NOT project to a live positive.

attribution.description: STEP 6. Who is speaking and in what mode. FIRST_PARTY = the sender instructing the recipient now (a live directive). REPORTED = the user recounting what someone else said ('the scammer asked me to...'). QUOTED = verbatim quotation of third-party content. HYPOTHETICAL = conditional/educational ('fraudsters may ask...'). Only FIRST_PARTY AFFIRMED directives project to LIVE positive indicators; REPORTED/QUOTED/HYPOTHETICAL feed REPORTED_SCAM_NARRATIVE / EDUCATIONAL_CONTENT.

mood.description: STEP 6. Instruction vs description. DIRECTIVE tells the recipient to do something; DESCRIPTIVE narrates/warns; INTERROGATIVE asks. A DESCRIPTIVE mention of a risky action is not a live request.

canonical_value.description: The normalised concept the observation represents (e.g. 'REQUEST_DISCLOSE_OTP', an FO/UA/TM dimension term, or a controlled phrase). Stable across surface forms and — where a dimensions-v1.json term applies — SHOULD be that term's id (checked leniently by the linter).

normalized_value.description: A normalised surface rendering (e.g. lowercased, expanded). Optional.

raw_span.description: The exact substring of the source that evidences this observation. The original input span must remain traceable (STEP 3): even when offsets are unavailable, this preserves the words.

offsets.description: Half-open [start,end) offsets into the envelope's content.normalized_text. Optional because some modalities (OCR, narrative paraphrase) cannot always supply exact offsets; raw_span still anchors the evidence.

confidence.description: EXTRACTION confidence — how sure we are the text means this. Distinct from rule confidence (STEP 10). Never an input to a risk score (CONF-001).

actor.description: STEP 7. WHO is asking. For IDENTITY_ASSERTION this is the impersonated identity.

claimed_identity.description: Controlled label for the claimed identity, e.g. AUTHORITY_LAW_ENFORCEMENT, AUTHORITY_BANK, EXECUTIVE, RELATIVE, KNOWN_CONTACT, CELEBRITY, MERCHANT, UNKNOWN. A claim only; never a verified identity.

verified.description: Whether the claimed identity is independently verified. UNKNOWN by default; impersonation detection never assumes YES.

party_ref.description: Which envelope party this maps to.

action.description: STEP 7. WHAT is being asked/done. Keyed to a requested_user_action (UA-*) or technical_mechanism (TM-*) dimension term where one applies.

type.description: Controlled action label, e.g. DISCLOSE_CREDENTIAL, ENTER_UPI_PIN, MAKE_PAYMENT, SCAN_QR, INSTALL_APP, GRANT_PERMISSION, DIAL_CODE, CONNECT_WALLET, LINK_DEVICE, OPEN_LINK, SHARE_CODE. SHOULD correspond to a UA-* term.

dimension_ref.description: Optional UA-*/TM-* dimension term id this action realises.

target.description: STEP 7/8. TO/FOR WHAT. The object of the action.

amount.description: Magnitude, if the action concerns money. Not a risk value (CONF-001).

recipient_label.description: Controlled label for the payee/beneficiary where determinable, e.g. MERCHANT, UNKNOWN_ACCOUNT, SELF. Payee IDENTITY resolution is out of scope (TL-PAY-003 is DEFERRED).

credential_kind.description: For AUTHENTICATION_ACTION, which secret is at issue.

instrument.description: For DEVICE_ACTION, the named app/permission/code (e.g. AnyDesk, Accessibility, a USSD string). Controlled or verbatim.

payment_direction.description: STEP 8. Only meaningful on PAYMENT_CONTEXT / AUTHENTICATION_ACTION involving payment. Direction is NOT inferred from the mere presence of currency or UPI terminology: when the text does not settle it, the value is UNKNOWN_DIRECTION and status SHOULD be AMBIGUOUS. USER_RECEIVES + a credential/PIN prompt is the receive-fraud contradiction (RESEARCH-003 ADV-003 #1); USER_PAYS to a named merchant is legitimate outbound (PAY_MERCHANT_DIRECTION).

pressure.description: STEP 7. The coercive lever, for THREAT/TEMPORAL_PRESSURE observations. Keyed to a social_engineering_tactic (SE-*) term where one applies.

threat_of.description: For kind=THREAT, the stated consequence: ARREST, ACCOUNT_BLOCK, SERVICE_SUSPENSION, LEGAL_ACTION, EXPOSURE, FINANCIAL_LOSS.

pretext.description: STEP 7. UNDER WHICH PRETEXT the request is framed.

kind.description: Controlled pretext label, e.g. KYC_UPDATE, VERIFICATION, REFUND, PARCEL_DELIVERY, JOB_OFFER, INVESTMENT, ACCOUNT_SECURITY, TECHNICAL_SUPPORT, PRIZE.

url_ref.description: For LINK_ACTION, the url_id (url-observation.schema.json) this observation concerns.

provenance.description: STEP 11. HOW this observation was produced — the extractor identity/type/version. Underpins the explanation chain input → span → observation → indicator → rule → evidence → result.

derived_from.description: observation_ids this observation was composed from, where it aggregates finer observations. Optional; keeps composition auditable.

confidence.description: STEP 10. Categorical by default; an optional numeric score is permitted for ordering/triage ONLY and is explicitly not a probability of fraud. method records which was used.

score.description: Advisory extraction score in [0,1]. NEVER a risk/fraud probability and never aggregated into a finding (CONF-001, DET-001 deferred).

extractor_type.description: STEP 11. Provenance type, NOT permission to implement all of them now. WP2 defines the vocabulary; which extractors exist is a later-phase decision.

config_ref.description: Pointer to the pattern-pack / model / prompt version, where applicable.
